mc_photon_slab — CONVERGE montecarlo op

• 数据种类:无 → table(仅由参数决定的算子 —— 不接受图像或数据输入)

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mc_photon_slab(layers=None, n_above=1.0, n_below=1.0, n_photons=100000, tol=None, confidence=0.95, batch=50000, seed=1, w_threshold=0.0001, roulette_m=10) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import mcphoton; mcphoton.mc_photon_slab(layers=None, n_above=1.0, n_below=1.0, n_photons=100000, tol=None, confidence=0.95, batch=50000, seed=1, w_threshold=0.0001, roulette_m=10) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsconverge.get("mc_photon_slab"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

用 MCML 型蒙特卡罗计算多层浑浊平板的漫反射、总透射和吸收，并给出置信区间。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

layers: list of {"n", "mua", "mus", "g", "d"} from the top (coefficients in 1/length, thickness in the same length; d = inf for a semi-infinite last layer). n_above / n_below: ambient refractive indices. A pencil beam enters at normal incidence.

The tracing rules are those of the MCML manual (Wang & Jacques), eqs. 3.2a-3.31 — see the module docstring for which equation does what. Every packet's contribution is kept, so the standard error is the sample standard deviation over packets / sqrt(N) and the interval is mean +- z se (confidence). Batch b uses default_rng((seed, b)).

• tol=None: trace n_photons packets.

• tol=h: sequential Monte Carlo — add batches of batch packets until the half-width of R_d and of T_t is <= h (the stopping rule of converge, from the second batch on), with n_photons as the budget: refusing (NotConvergedError) if the budget is spent first.

Returns Rd, Tt, A (absorbed fraction) and A_layers, each with *_se and *_ci; Rsp (specular, deterministic: eq. 3.2a); energy_balance = R_sp + R_d + T_t + A (1 in expectation — roulette conserves energy only on average, so its deviation is compared with its own standard error); R_total = R_sp + R_d (specular plus diffuse, with the interval of R_d shifted by the deterministic R_sp); n_photons. Defaults: the MCML manual Table 6.1 slab (van de Hulst: R_d = 0.09739, T_t = 0.66096); MCML_TABLE_6_2 holds Table 6.2.
